method: FFmpeg decode each input to mono 44100Hz; correlate 0.65-second MP4 waveform against +-90ms surrounding MP3, FFT valid correlation
convention: positive means MP3 waveform is later than matching content in MP4 audio
warnings: This is a source-to-source media offset, not input/output device latency
Container timestamps both start at zero; relative waveform alignment differs due to encoding/priming
Do not assume waveform beats are the player-input chart
MP3 includes gameplay SFX and result sequence, not verified clean BGM stem
